preamble: Debuccalization of the voiced postalveolar fricative /ʒ/ to [h] is a regional feature of Louisiana French in Terrebonne and Lafourche parishes, where /ʒ/ (spelled j, g) is variably pronounced as a glottal fricative; the process occasionally extends to /ʃ/, /s/ and /z/. No comparable direct ʒ > h change is securely documented elsewhere.

examples.note: Variable aspiration of /ʒ/ in south Lafourche Parish.
Word-medial /ʒ/ is also affected; variation between [ʒ] and [h] is stylistic.
